description: This is a C++ source file implementing the UsbAccess plugin class for managing USB device interactions, including mounting, file listing, firmware update, and log archiving within a device system, using IARM for event handling and various system utilities.

classes.name: UsbAccess
classes.description: Main plugin class managing USB device interactions, including mount detection, file operations, firmware updates, and logging, using callbacks and system utilities.

methods.name: getFileListWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to list files in a specified directory, applying regex filters.

methods.name: createLinkWrapper
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link to a USB device directory.

methods.name: clearLinkWrapper
methods.description: Removes a previously created symbolic link.

methods.name: getLinksWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves all existing symbolic links to USB devices.

methods.name: getAvailableFirmwareFilesWrapper
methods.description: Lists available firmware files from mounted USB devices and additional paths.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Validates filename and initiates firmware update process.

methods.name: getMountedWrapper
methods.description: Returns list of currently mounted USB paths.

methods.name: archiveLogsInternal
methods.description: Performs log archiving, calling external script and handling result.

methods.name: onArchiveLogs
methods.description: Callback to notify about log archive result and path.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles IARM events, notably USB mount changes.

methods.name: onUSBMountChanged
methods.description: Notifies system about USB mount status change.

methods.name: getFileList
methods.description: Reads directory contents filtering by regex, including folder options.

methods.name: getMounted
methods.description: Enumerates USB block devices and corresponding mount points.
